LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction01.label: Corporation
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction01.description: A structure built on profit and production. Power belongs to capital, and decisions are made by those who control resources.
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction02.label: Cartel
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction02.description: An alliance controlling profitable industries and markets. They operate in the shadows, balancing between law and darkness.
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction03.label: Alliance
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction03.description: A union of several powers for a common goal. Often unstable, but powerful as long as participants' interests align.
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction04.label: Union
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction04.description: A grouping of enterprises or settlements linked by economy or defense. Their cohesion is born from shared survival.
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction05.label: Factory
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction05.description: A disciplined production system where man is a cog in the machine. Symbol of industrial efficiency and hard labor.
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction06.label: Plant
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction06.description: A place of endless flow of goods, noise, and steam. Workers live in the shadow of machines, feeding progress with their sweat.
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction07.label: Union
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction07.description: A community of laborers defending their rights. Sometimes peaceful, sometimes ready to revolt for justice.
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction08.label: Association
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction08.description: A flexible network of specialists and masters. Their strength lies in cooperation and the free exchange of knowledge.
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction09.label: Complex
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction09.description: A closed structure uniting factories, laboratories, and settlements. Often lives by its own laws and statutes.
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction10.label: Organization
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction10.description: A strictly structured authority with hierarchy and order. Inside, struggles of interests and hidden ambitions rage.
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction11.label: City
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction11.description: The heart of industrial civilization. Towers, smoke, and neon create the pulse of a living metropolis.
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction12.label: Front
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction12.description: A military or ideological alliance. Fights not only with weapons, but with words, influence, and faith.
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction13.label: Global Union
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction13.description: An agreement between peoples or corporations. Behind the facade of unity always lies competition.
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction14.label: League
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction14.description: An old alliance with traditions and statutes. Often turns into an elitist gathering where the fate of others is decided.
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction15.label: Fleet
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction15.description: An organized force dominating on water or in the air. Symbol of mobility and military might of the machine age.
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction16.label: Collective
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction16.description: A community where equality is more important than status. Their ideals often clash with the harsh reality of industry.
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction17.label: Nation
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction17.description: A people united by common culture and purpose. Their pride drives progress forward, but easily turns into fanaticism.
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction18.label: Coalition
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction18.description: A temporary alliance of forces against a greater threat. After victory, it often collapses under the weight of disagreements.
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction19.label: Society
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction19.description: A union of people with shared beliefs or goals. Defines the spirit of the era—progressive or dogmatic.
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction20.label: Company
LanguageData.DF_IndustrialFaction20.description: A group driven by profit and ambition. From small traders to huge corporations—adventure always lies at their heart.
